title: Bedside Mini Shelf with Cable Hole
author: HaniHashemi
description:
This is a simple, compact shelf designed in Shapr3D to stick next to your bed or any wall surface. It’s perfect for holding small items like your phone, SIM cards, or accessories. The built-in hole allows you to neatly pass through a charging cable or drop small items like SIM cards for safekeeping.

It’s my first 3D design not perfect, but functional and a great start for anyone looking to customize their space with a personal touch.

Ideal for 3D printing with PLA. You might want to print it flat for better adhesion and strength, or rotate based on your printer’s capabilities.
